mapper.sql: merchant_user_id, tenant_id, member_id, user_name, nick_name, phone, email, avatar, password, status, del_flag, login_ip, login_date, pwd_update_date, must_change_password, create_time
mapper.select: select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` where user_name = #{username} and del_flag = '0'
select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` where phone = #{phone} and del_flag = '0'
select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` where merchant_user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'
select from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` where email = #{email} and del_flag = '0'
select auth_status from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` where contact_phone = #{phone} and del_flag = '0' order by member_id desc limit 1

select um.tenant_id, um.member_id, um.merchant_user_id, um.member_role, um.warehouse_scope_type from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_user_member` um inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m on m.tenant_id = um.tenant_id and m.member_id = um.member_id where um.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and um.status = '0' and um.del_flag = '0' and m.auth_status = 'verified' and m.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' order by um.id limit 1

select count(1) from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_user_member` um inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_member` m on m.tenant_id = um.tenant_id and m.member_id = um.member_id where um.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and um.status = '0' and um.del_flag = '0' and m.auth_status = 'verified' and m.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0'

select distinct r.role_key from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` ur on ur.tenant_id = r.tenant_id and ur.member_id = r.member_id and ur.role_id = r.role_id where r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and r.member_id = #{merchantId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0'

select distinct m.perms from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` m where m.tenant_id = 0 and m.member_id = 0 and m.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' and m.perms is not null and m.perms != '' and ( exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_menu` um where um.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and um.member_id = #{merchantId} and um.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and um.menu_id = m.menu_id) or exists (select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user_role` ur inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` r on r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and r.member_id = ur.member_id and r.role_id = ur.role_id inner join `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` rm on rm.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id and rm.member_id = ur.member_id and rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and ur.member_id = #{merchantId} and ur.merchant_user_id = #{userId} and rm.menu_id = m.menu_id and r.status = '0' and r.del_flag = '0') )

select warehouse_id, warehouse_code, warehouse_name from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_warehouse` where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{merchantId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0' order by warehouse_name, warehouse_id
mapper.update: update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` set login_ip = #{loginIp}, login_date = #{loginDate} where merchant_user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'

update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` set nick_name = #{nickname}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, update_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = sysdate() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{merchantId} and merchant_user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'

update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` set avatar = #{avatar}, update_by = #{updatedBy}, update_time = sysdate() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{merchantId} and merchant_user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0'

update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` set password = #{password}, pwd_update_date = sysdate(), must_change_password = 0, update_time = sysdate() where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{merchantId} and merchant_user_id = #{userId} and del_flag = '0' and must_change_password = 1
mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` (tenant_id, member_id, user_name, nick_name, phone, email, password, status, del_flag, must_change_password, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{account.tenantId}, #{account.merchantId}, #{account.username}, #{account.nickname}, #{account.phone}, #{account.email}, null, '0', '0', 1, #{operator}, sysdate(), '商户审核通过后自动开通的管理员账号，首次登录需设置密码')
mapper.update: update `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_user` set tenant_id = #{account.tenantId}, member_id = #{account.merchantId}, nick_name = #{account.nickname}, email = #{account.email}, status = '0', del_flag = '0', must_change_password = case when password is null or password = '' then 1 else must_change_password end, update_by = #{operator}, update_time = sysdate() where merchant_user_id = #{account.userId}
mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_user_member` (tenant_id, member_id, merchant_user_id, member_role, warehouse_scope_type, sensitive_scope, status, create_by, create_time, del_flag) values (#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{userId}, 'owner', 'all', 'detail', '0', #{operator}, sysdate(), '0')
mapper.select: select role_id from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and member_id = #{merchantId} and role_key = 'merchant_admin' and del_flag = '0' order by role_id limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role` (tenant_id, member_id, role_name, role_key, role_sort, menu_check_strictly, status, create_by, create_time, remark, del_flag) values (#{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, '商户管理员', 'merchant_admin', 1, 1, '0', #{operator}, sysdate(), '商户审核通过后自动创建的管理员角色', '0')

insert into `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` (tenant_id, member_id, role_id, menu_id) select #{tenantId}, #{merchantId}, #{roleId}, m.menu_id from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_menu` m where m.tenant_id = 0 and m.member_id = 0 and m.status = '0' and m.del_flag = '0' and not exists ( select 1 from `ry_rental`.`ry_rental_merchant_role_menu` rm where rm.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and rm.member_id = #{merchantId} and rm.role_id = #{roleId} and rm.menu_id = m.menu_id )
